# Skeu

> Skeu (https://skeu.app) puts a screenshot in a window frame, on a background, with a soft shadow, for launch posts, docs, product pages and slides. It runs in the browser; images are never uploaded, and there's no account.

## What it does

- Window frames: light or dark macOS-style window around the screenshot, or none
- Size, roundness, padding and a shadow with adjustable offset, blur, spread and color
- 3D tilt, rotation, and snapping to the edges and corners of the canvas
- Gradient or solid backgrounds, from presets or any color
- Crop, with edges that snap to straight lines in the image (for example, a browser's address bar)
- Canvas sizes: match the image, 16:9, 4:3, 1:1, 3:2, 9:16, or drag to any size
- Export PNG, JPG or WebP at 1×, 2× or 3×, or copy to the clipboard
- Works on phones: pinch to scale
- Undo and redo for every change

## Pages

- [Home](https://skeu.app): features and frequently asked questions
- [Editor](https://skeu.app/editor): the app itself
